{{Quote|Well, the bounty hunter we ran into on Ord Mantell changed my mind.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''mission to Ord Mantell''' took place during the [[Yavin blockade]].

==Prelude==
After the [[Mission to Jarnollen]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was damaged and its crew forced to go to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in order to repair the ship.

==On Ord Mantell==
After the reparation of the ''Millennium Falcon'', the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Skorr/Legends|Skorr]] and [[Gribbet]] discovered the presence of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] and decided to capture him and earn the bounty placed on his head by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

[[File:Classic_02_03.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] approaches Ten Mile Plateau in a [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper]].]]

At night, they captured [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and proposed Solo to exchange them. They hope to capture Han Solo during the exchange. The exchange was done in the [[Stellar-energy station]] atop the [[Ten Mile Plateau]]. Eventually, they were rescued by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in a [[Cargo lifter|cargo flyer]].

==In space==
The rebels escaped the planet with the ''Millennium Falcon''. In the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], they were caught between an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] on maneuvers and [[Skorr's starship]]. Eventually, the rebels manage to lure the Imperials and the bounty hunters were captured by an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].

[[File:Falcon_Vader_OrdMantell.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] pursued the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].]]

After that, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived in his [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] and attacked the ''Millennium Falcon'' but the rebels managed to escape.

==Aftermath==
The rebels left the system and joined [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The two bounty hunters were sent to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].

==Behind the scenes==
This story was created by [[Archie Goodwin]] from a line [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] said at the beginning of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']]: ''...the bounty hunter we ran into on Ord Mantell changed my mind''.
